Kimberly / Jules —

Attached is the exported math and the per-day unit rates I’m using. Summary below:
- Monthly Starter unit price: €420 / seat (monthly recurring)
- Monthly Dedicated unit price: €1,250 / seat (monthly recurring)
- Pro-rate = (monthly unit price / 30) * days on tier

Example (18 seats):
- Starter (6 days): (420/30)*6*18 = €9,072
- Dedicated (24 days): (1250/30)*24*18 = €360,000
- Migration handling fee (one-time): €720
- Gross total (pre-VAT): €369,792

VAT handling: because Aurorium is VAT-registered in the EU and Redwood is supplying the Dedicated service from the US with a customer in the EU, we should apply reverse-charge to the Dedicated line and report the Starter line as domestic VATable (per their VAT id jurisdiction). I’ve left a column in the sheet for the customer VAT ID — Jules, can you confirm the EU VAT number you want printed on the invoice?

Marissa — for collections: Aurorium asked to pay via SEPA net30. Can we ensure the invoice includes a single total with per-line VAT annotations and bank details (SEPA beneficiary) so AR can accept a single payment? If tax needs to be broken out for AP, we can append a VAT summary page.

On bank details: we will use our EUR collection account (IBAN on final invoice). Banking ops will do SEPA reconciliation; if Aurorium requires an invoice per legal entity (they have two EU subsidiaries), we may need to issue split invoices. I’ve noted that as a conditional fallback.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
